Use the maintained authentication implementation for sessions and privileged MFA. Invitations are single-use, expiring and scope-bound; possession of an invite does not bypass identity establishment or current grant authority.
Distinguish possessed capabilities from delegable capabilities. Member-management does not imply administrator-grant or ownership-transfer rights; no self-elevation or last-owner lockout.
Enforce independent vendor-staff, commercial-contact, customer-staff, principal and service identities at every API/job/search/export boundary, with local recovery and revocation checks.
Model organisation, legal entity, environment, membership and optional subtenant as separate concepts; no automatic tenant per employee and no inferred consent sharing across a group.
Bind tenant context to validated authority. Require scoped keys, predicates and tenant-aware foreign references for every owned record, including background work and exports.
Provide create/update/suspend and delegated environment administration with version checks and audit. Suspension cannot erase evidence or silently relax accepted privacy restrictions.
Keep vendor commercial accounts in a separate store with their own assignment checks. A shared design system is not a shared database, cookie store or privileged key.

Provide relational entities and typed relationships for the source graph, including data assets/datasets/fields, processing activities, copies, recipients and ownership. Start with PostgreSQL, not a new graph database.
Ingest scoped connector discovery and customer declarations with distinct asserted/observed provenance, review state, recorded/valid time and freshness. Do not infer purpose from a field name alone.
Provide bounded, authorised traversal and full-text/keyword search. Changing a system/processor/purpose relationship identifies affected policies, workflows, tests, assessments and owners.
Preserve historical links needed by old evidence. Deletion of personal payloads leaves only justified integrity/tombstone references, not an invisible rewrite of history.

Maintain versioned purposes and processing conditions; do not treat all activity as consent-based or import generic legitimate-interest permission. Store reviewed source/applicability separately from executable technical rules.
Implement draft/review/approval/publication/supersession without editing published versions. Approval binds exact version/digest and configured maker/checker checks.

Return the master decision vocabulary with reason codes, exact policy/version, scope, freshness, consent epoch and enforceable obligations. A consumer unable to mask/restrict must reject or escalate, not return unrestricted success.

Keep administrative authorisation and processing decisions in distinct namespaces. Runtime projections/bundles serve supported low-latency paths; no full inventory scan, long workflow or model call in the hot path.
Commit accepted domain state and outbox event atomically; deliver at least once with inbox/deduplication and aggregate-version checks. No in-memory-only business queue.

Create typed plan versions and separately recorded action attempts, approvals, commands, receipts, observations and reconciliations. Bind approval to identity, generation, scope, budget, policy and expiry.
Treat a lost response after an effect as unknown. Reconcile via supported receipt/readback; retry only with proven idempotence or a safe supported operation. Unsafe uncertainty requires review.

Support pause, escalation, manual tasks, dead-letter inspection and version-safe resumption. Retain the executing definition version; cancellation stops new work safely but cannot promise to undo irreversible effects.
Declare versioned resource/action/permission-specific capability manifests: discovery, matching, read, plan, action, reconciliation and verification; expose limitations and consistency windows.

Implement local guided setup with TLS checks, dedicated service identities, secret references, explicit resource allowlists, mapping review, dry-run and Observe-first activation. No automatic self-grant or root/DBA shortcut.

Have the agent independently validate command signature, identity, installation, environment, nonce, expiry, capability, generation, approval digest and budget. Separate update trust from execution trust.

Provide controlled database/API adapters, pagination completeness, partial results, rate limits, circuit breakers, bounded spool and revocation. Keep file/manual onboarding visibly separate from live integration.
Record configuration, capability, attempt, acknowledgement, observation, test and integrity as separate dimensions, not levels of one universal compliance score.
Attach claim, scope, method, observation time, source, connector/policy version, generation, consistency delay, validity and limitations to every outcome claim.
Invalidate freshness after the declared window or material control/system change. Reopen the associated gap when observation fails or loses coverage.
Treat provider assertions and manual attestations as attributable statements, not independent scoped observation. Sampling must state its sample and cannot substantiate whole-population deletion.
Create append-oriented events for material privacy actions with exact policy/workflow/action/actor/approval/version references. Corrections append rather than replace.
Separate minimal evidence envelopes from protected personal payloads. Apply per-class retention across payloads, indexes, exports and backups; tombstones explain intentional deletion.
Generate permission-scoped local JSON, supported CSV/PDF and signed packages; prevent third-party disclosure, audit creation/access and support expiring authenticated delivery.
Provide an offline integrity verifier that reports manifest/hash/signature continuity and separately states that integrity is not proof of external-world truth.
Model versioned test definitions with preconditions, permitted synthetic scope, steps, expected results, severity, policy and environment.

Execute supported actions and independently inspect outcomes; store expected/actual per assertion, run identity, build, interruptions and cleanup. A failed control remains FAIL even when detection worked correctly.
Block accidental targeting of real/destructive production records. Use explicit synthetic identities, generation checks and resource budgets, including cleanup safety.
Provide machine-readable results, run history, schedules and supported CI integration. The product test engine and ORVIA development QA remain different responsibilities.
Drive in-app/email/approved-webhook notifications from durable events with template version, recipient scope, purpose and preference rules where applicable.
Use customer-controlled delivery for operational/principal messages; vendor billing notifications use separately designated business contacts only.
Separate queued, sent, delivered, failed and acknowledged evidence; use retry/deduplication and local escalation without silently resetting deadlines.
Keep legal declarations and regulator dispatch subject to customer review; no fabricated Board filing integration. No proactive diagnostic stream to vendor support.
Capture exact notice digest/version/language, affirmative interaction, purpose scope, source and time without device fingerprinting as a substitute for validity.
Maintain an authoritative scope/principal/purpose aggregate and monotonic epoch; record event and outbox atomically. Old grants cannot overwrite a withdrawal.
Distinguish fresh authorised re-consent from retries; recheck record generation/current authority before stale work affects newly authorised records.
Keep channel preferences, consent and suppression distinct. Imported consent retains SUPPORTED/INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE/CONFLICTING/REVIEW_REQUIRED provenance and never blindly overrides newer decisions.
Create draft, reviewed and immutable published notice variants tied to purposes, data categories, effective dates and contact information.
Preserve exact content digests and language/version relationships; do not render a historic receipt using the newest notice.
Classify notice changes as editorial, translation or material scope change; store an approved migration/fresh-consent decision and affected grants.
Provide understandable accessible presentation and review of legally significant translations. English-first administration must not erase required principal language choices.
Serve notices, consent, withdrawals, requests, grievances and supported representation flows from customer-controlled services with locally bundled assets.
Enforce self/mandate-scoped reads and non-enumerating public status; proportionate identity verification does not require blanket identity-document collection.
Provide accessible, language-aware, low-bandwidth/assisted journeys, honest pending states and secure upload/delivery for required evidence and responses.
Separate public portal exposure from private administration and databases; no vendor proxy, session replay, external chat widget or operational telemetry.
Implement the master request state vocabulary with independent identity, authority, execution, response and unresolved-scope dimensions.
Support exact/strong/probable/ambiguous/no-match review; ambiguous identity blocks disclosure and destructive automation. A verified channel is not universal ownership of all historic records.
Model nomination and guardian mandates separately, including revocation, permitted scope, invocation and adulthood/authority changes. Baseline child safeguards apply where processing is supported.
Plan per-system actions, retention exceptions and response redaction; retain manual/unverified destinations. CLOSED is administrative closure, not universal erasure.
Evaluate retention per copy/category/processing context with trigger, source, minimum/maximum constraints, permitted use, owner and review/release condition.
Create exact-scope legal holds and reviewed conflict decisions. Neither longest-duration retention nor generic business need is a universal override.
Execute bounded copy-level suppression/deletion through supported adapters with dependency order, generation checks, budgets, checkpoints and approval.

Record live-store, derived-copy, processor and backup outcomes separately. Restore into quarantine and reconcile current restrictions before resuming; crypto deletion is optional advanced scope with explicit key-copy limitations.
Capture processor relationships, authorised purpose/data/subprocessor scope, region, contract reference, owner and incident/action contacts locally.
Track processor notification, acknowledgement and independent verification as different facts; missing API integration becomes attributed coordination work.
Link assessments, findings, exceptions and remediation tasks to actual systems, purposes and controls; closure needs defined evidence or a retest.
Activate SDF/sector-specific assessment workflows only through reviewed applicability; a questionnaire or runtime pass does not certify all organisational duties.
Record occurrence, detection, awareness and each obligation trigger with source/reviewer; corrections append and do not silently restart clocks.
Link affected systems, purposes, controls, processors and principal scope with evidence and uncertainty. Severity is configurable deterministic policy, not inferred law.
Create independent applicability/deadline/draft/review/dispatch tasks per recipient/regime; use approved rule packs rather than hard-coded universal hours.
Escalate overdue reviews and uncertain delivery; produce a manual submission package where no supported authorised filing channel exists.
Compute coverage by declared inventory/resource/action/permission/verification scope and timestamp, showing numerator, denominator and exclusions.
Surface failed, manual, unknown, pending and unverified states without assuming they are disjoint counts that may be summed.
Derive gaps from real observation, capability changes, stale inventory and tests; provide owner, severity, deadline and evidence-linked actions.
Offer optional exact error-to-runbook guidance; no rule match may certify a root cause, close an unresolved action or create an ALLOW decision.
Keep business account, designated contacts, subscription, invoice and payment references on the vendor side; collect no local member directory or customer usage records.
Calculate purchase terms server-side from an approved catalogue; a browser payment-success redirect is not authoritative proof of payment.
Handle signed/provider-verified payment callbacks, deduplication and delayed/out-of-order events through an approved payment adapter; retain invoice and entitlement history.
Show plan/renewal/cancellation transitions transparently; apply local licence continuity instead of remotely destroying or weakening privacy controls.
Issue immutable, schema-validated licences containing only edition, entitlements, validity and licensed limits, with permitted installation binding where needed.
Verify trusted signer, audience, signature, schema, installation/validity locally; reject command-like fields, new endpoints and authority grants.
Support offline import and renewal with defined trusted-time, revocation freshness and replay rules. Exact durations/limits remain an owner-reviewed policy, not guessed defaults.
Keep release signing, licence signing and customer execution/decryption authority separate; vendor outage cannot become a hidden runtime dependency.
Separate release availability, deployment support, controlled rollout, licence entitlement and actor authorisation; all must be satisfied for use.
Use one codebase and shared domain engines across Foundation/Control/Enterprise, with a central capability vocabulary rather than scattered price checks.
Define expiry/downgrade transitions per operation: complete/hand off accepted work, preserve restrictions, maintain authorised access/export/recovery as the approved policy requires.
Never unlock V2 AI, vendor remote access, staff sync or proactive diagnostics through a flag or paid tier; essential security and truthful outcomes are common.
Keep purchase/download on vendor services and installation/configuration inside the customer boundary; verify the complete package before privileged setup.
Validate runtime/profile/architecture, TLS, storage, identity, keys, backups and egress; create one protected primary owner and customer-held recovery, never demo production accounts.
Provide the nine-step local connection wizard, granular permission checks, resource/mapping review and Observe-to-approved-enforcement transition.
Provide explicitly supported local imports/manual forms with quarantine, preview, conflict handling, provenance and purge; source snapshots are never live control evidence.
Generate a fixed-schema report locally from approved product versions, error/check-result enums and permitted support references; no free-form operational summary, logs or directory.
Preview exact payload, destination, purpose and retention. Bind approval to payload digest and revalidate before transfer; edits/new reports require new approval.
Validate vendor ingress without persisting rejected bodies; authorise assigned staff/cases and handle accidental forbidden submissions through isolation/minimisation procedures.
Provide reviewed instructions or a signed customer-applied patch, and keep vendor case resolution distinct from local control verification. No live remote-access path or standing telemetry.
Publish immutable signed manifests, dependency inventories, provenance, migration/compatibility notes and supported versions from reviewed releases.
Keep artifact download eligibility separate from execution. Customer-controlled installation verifies trusted origin, safe unpacking, digests and approved maintenance actions.
Use compatibility-aware migrations, recoverable rollout and versioned workflow execution. Do not claim rollback when the schema requires tested forward recovery.
Prevent updates from silently enabling vendor data egress, excluded support features, model dependencies or unsafe downgrade; rerun boundaries and core regression after changes.
Collect bounded local health/logs/metrics/traces with secret/payload minimisation; distinguish liveness, readiness and business readiness.
Measure propagation lag, oldest unresolved work, freshness, queue saturation, connector limits, storage and backup status, not just uptime.
Back up customer domain/workflow/evidence/configuration under customer-held keys; restore into quarantine and reconcile current authority/restrictions before resuming.
Show vendor-side only its own service health and timestamped per-case reported facts; no automatic customer telemetry, employee tracking or model-absence incident.
Audit role grants, owner changes, policy publication, connector credentials/scope, support approval, exports, licences and updates with correct tenant/domain/actor context.
Separate local operational audit from vendor staff access and commercial/support audit. No mirroring of member activities into vendor profiles.
Provide scoped read/export/filter permissions, restricted audit administration and append-only correction semantics; audit reads/exports where sensitive.
Apply purpose-based retention with payload minimisation and tested backup handling; preserve truthful envelope history when justified payload deletion occurs.
Control packages bundle applicability, policy, adapter needs, tests, evidence schema and declared limitations; customer maps/reviews/tests before activation.
Change simulation shows affected purposes, notices, systems, copies, tests and owners with assumptions and graph coverage limitations; it performs no hidden production mutation.
Assessments/findings/remediation connect to controls and closure evidence; applicable SDF and guardian safeguards require source-reviewed decisions.
Deliver a complete signed ZIP product from vendor distribution for supported server/Kubernetes/offline profiles; customer-controlled operation and keys are common to editions.
Customer exports/offboarding remain local and usable, revoke integrations/identities safely and preserve required records; vendor-held business deletion follows its separate policy.
Optional Guided Assistance uses rules/templates/local search and cannot delay required errors, manual support or core operation.
Vendor readiness content collects only fields admitted by the minimum-data contract; source tension about system/maturity questions is an OPEN review, not permission for inventory upload.
Isolation across authority domains, tenants/legal entities/environments/subtenants, APIs, queues, object paths, search, exports and caches; test denied paths.
Durability for accepted events and safe repeated delivery; effect uncertainty is explicit. Run crash/restart/replay tests, not a diagram-based exactly-once claim.
Security controls, no unresolved applicable Critical/High findings, independent defined-scope review/retest, no score-only waiver of boundary defects.
Locality includes UI assets, telemetry, support drafts, histories, backups and imported payloads; no permitted-schema covert expansion into operational data.
Accessible keyboard/screen-reader flows, plain-language outcomes, language/version/timezone support and tested browser matrix. Quantitative conformance claim requires assessment.

Preserve existing illustrative targets: control-plane p95 <500 ms, simple local policy p95 <100 ms, connected marketing propagation p95 <30 s. Benchmark with defined workload/hardware; these are not SLAs or already-achieved metrics.
Recovery objectives are set per supported profile/data class and measured; restore must reconcile current restrictions and authority before resuming. No invented RPO/RTO.
Signed, reproducible, versioned packages and migration/workflow/connector compatibility; documented unsupported profiles and upgrade recovery.
Local rate limits, concurrency/load budgets and circuit breaking protect customer systems. Determine limits by measurement and customer permission.
Explainable minimum code; no unused production files, duplicated state models, uncontrolled dependency additions or fake implementations.

open_decisions.decision: Current source paths, branch and ownership
open_decisions.required_resolution: Current checkout and any uncommitted changes; choose/apply one requested frontend/backend/database path map and current four-track ownership.
open_decisions.blocks: Structural moves or concurrent edits to affected paths.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Use verified current paths and isolated read-only review; no duplicated tree.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Exact products/versions, resource/action scope, authorisation, credentials and synthetic test accounts.
open_decisions.blocks: Provider-specific action/verification and corresponding customer claims.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Build reviewed adapter contract and fixtures; no fake real integration.

open_decisions.decision: Payment provider, commercial catalogue and taxes
open_decisions.required_resolution: Provider callback verification, plan prices/currency/tax/invoice/refund/cancellation semantics and test account.
open_decisions.blocks: Real checkout/payment/licence issuance from payment truth.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Implement provider-neutral verified event boundary; no chosen vendor/price invented.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Edition capability map, offline validity/renewal/revocation, grace/read-only/hand-off and trusted-time policy.
open_decisions.blocks: Production issuance, expiry/downgrade behaviour and public promises.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Enforce no data wipe or privacy fail-open; represent unresolved policy explicitly.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Authoritative consolidated sources, commencement/applicability, interpretation and reviewed operational controls.
open_decisions.blocks: Legal pack activation and public compliance/collection claims.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Keep source/interpretation/applicability versioned and unapproved content non-active; do not infer fixed deadlines.

open_decisions.blocks: Support claims and production package acceptance.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Retain synthetic evaluation limits; target Linux container deployment is design, not certification.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Selected maintained auth-provider/version configuration, MFA, independent audiences and customer-held recovery protocol.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Reuse existing safe identity implementation; no custom auth/backdoor.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Release/licence/customer-command/session/encryption key separation, custody, rotation, revocation and trusted bootstrap.
open_decisions.blocks: Production signed distribution, licence issue and privileged commands.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: No shared development keys in production; public trust material alone gives no execution authority.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Actual store topology, backup boundaries, independently recoverable current restriction/authority information and measured loss/recovery windows.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Quarantine when current state cannot be established; no reconstructing new events from old backup.

open_decisions.decision: Record-class retention and vendor privacy handling
open_decisions.required_resolution: Field-purpose-source-recipient-access-retention/purge/backup/hold rules, contact correction and accidental submissions.
open_decisions.blocks: Public vendor collection and production payload/history lifecycle.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: No universal statutory retention numbers; no indefinite audit-payload collection.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Exact import types/fields/formats, parser library review, limits, row identity/provenance and atomic-versus-partial semantics.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Implement one approved typed path fully before another parser; no arbitrary upload-to-table tool.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Representative workload/hardware, pool/queue/scan budgets, decision latency/freshness and documented target failure modes.
open_decisions.blocks: Scale/latency/availability guarantees and destructive load budgets.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Use source candidate targets for tests, never advertise unmeasured numbers.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Named qualified assessor, actual assessment/retest scope and authorised approvers.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Agent review and static scans are engineering evidence, not independent penetration testing.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Review existing UI, required principal languages/notice variants and proposed WCAG 2.2 AA evaluation scope.
open_decisions.blocks: Language/accessibility claims and legally significant publication.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Reuse existing design; plain-language/keyboard/local-assets controls are required; no fabricated translations/conformance.

open_decisions.required_resolution: Resolve source §135 system/maturity suggestions against §31 collection inventory; approved fields and non-certificate wording.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Do not collect operational inventory just because it was suggested in older general wording.

open_decisions.decision: Support staffing, service terms and diagnostic taxonomy
open_decisions.required_resolution: Named response owners, actual support commitments, allowed public error/check/version fields, report transport/retention.
open_decisions.blocks: Published support promises and diagnostic ingress activation.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Direct support without AI; exact per-report approval; no resource-use summary or proactive feed.

open_decisions.decision: Wire and schema generalisation from synthetic scope
open_decisions.required_resolution: Versioned production principal/purpose/action/obligation schemas, domain ports, compatibility and current-at-effect authority strategy.
open_decisions.blocks: Replacing fixture restrictions, production connectors and action semantics.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Preserve current safe contract/tests; removing synthetic validators is not enough.

open_decisions.owner: D01 / product owner / relevant domain reviewer
open_decisions.required_resolution: Explicit source prerequisite satisfaction for CM interoperability, marketplace, advanced crypto or customer-AI-governance.
open_decisions.blocks: Claims/implementation outside currently selected supported scope.
open_decisions.safe_continuation: Preserve roadmap; no automatic deferral of unrelated V1 requirements and no hidden V2 model dependency.
